description: Read-only diagnostics for an existing Finance and Operations connection without reauthentication or configuration changes.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_1: No authentication profiles, MCP registrations, allowlists, environment settings, or local configuration files are changed.
PRIORITY_2: Executed dataverse org/data commands carry a bare --context value containing app, skill=dv-connect, and agent attribution.

tests.prompt: Diagnose my existing Finance and Operations connection, read-only. Identify the active Dataverse CLI environment and its linked ERP URL, then smoke-test access by reading at most one currency. Do not install tools, sign in again, switch profiles, register MCP, or change any configuration. If the existing connection is unavailable, report the exact blocker instead.
tests.expected_response: The agent loads dv-connect, checks dataverse auth who and org who, verifies ERP linkage for that profile, and runs a bounded Currencies read on the same ERP target. Missing linkage, authentication, permissions, and transport failures are reported distinctly without setup or a success claim.
tests.description: Diagnose ERP linkage and bounded read access without changing an existing connection.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory establishes the active Dataverse CLI profile and reads its linked ERP URL, or reports the observed connection blocker.
PRIORITY_1: When linkage is available, the agent reads Currencies on the ERP target with top 1; it never uses DataverseClient for the ERP read.
PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: The response distinguishes successful ERP data access from mere authentication or Dataverse connectivity and is grounded in actual tool results.
